description: Implementation of the ZoneService, handling operations related to geographical zones such as retrieving zones based on country and language, adding descriptions to zones, and caching zone data.

classes.name: ZoneServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing geographical zones, extending generic entity service and implementing ZoneService interface.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Zone entity based on its unique code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a zone, updating it if not already present.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches a list of zones for a given country and language, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves a map of zone codes to Zone objects for a specified language, utilizing cache.
